name: Yuyu Sakan e Yokoso!
source:
Nakazato Kazuma was put in charge of running the teahouse attached to his family home for the one month of summer vacation while his parents were away.

He planned to manage the small teahouse at a leisurely pace, but everything changed when a Chinese family restaurant opened next door to his house and demanded he vacate the premises for their parking lot expansion.

Insulted by their disregard for his teahouse, an enraged Kazuma accepted their condition: if he lost a tea ceremony competition against the family restaurant, he would move out. The problem was, he was a complete amateur when it came to the art of tea.

With three weeks left until the tea ceremony competition, his days of struggling to prepare while protecting the teahouse had begun...
translation:
中里和真在父母外出的一个月暑假期间，被安排负责经营自家附属的茶馆。

他原本打算悠闲地经营这家小茶馆，但当他家隔壁开了一家中式家庭餐馆，并要求他腾出场地以扩建停车场时，一切都发生了变化。

由于他们对他的茶馆的漠视而受到侮辱，愤怒的和真接受了他们的条件：如果他在与家庭餐馆的茶道比赛中输了，他就会搬出去。问题是，对于茶艺，他完全是个业余爱好者。

距离茶道比赛还有三个星期，他一边努力准备一边保护茶馆的日子开始了……
